summary:
Implementation plan for Phase 4: Alpha QA, Benchmarking & Hardening of MemoDiary.
Covers performance & scale benchmarking (10,000 entries database seeder, timeline pagination <=50ms, FTS5 latency <=500ms; 200-entry ingestion benchmark with >=95% accuracy and <=10s runtime), fault-tolerance & integrity verification (corrupted import atomic rollback, dirty draft autosave recovery, lossless template switching stress test), privacy & offline security audit (SQLCipher on-disk ciphertext check, zero-network quarantine via HttpOverrides and dependency audit), and release build verification (AndroidManifest/Info.plist audit, flutter analyze, flutter test).
